claims.object_text: West syndrome followed by Lennox-Gastaut syndrome
claims.quote: We report on 2 females with de novo variants in KCNT2 with West syndrome followed by Lennox-Gastaut syndrome
We report on 2 females with de novo variants in KCNT2 with West syndrome followed by Lennox-Gastaut syndrome or with DEE with migrating focal seizures.
in vitro analysis suggested quinidine-responsive gain-of-function effects
we treated 1 of the girls with quinidine add-on therapy and achieved marked clinical improvements.
